records.title: Clinical Fellowship 2027 — European Academy of Neurology

validation.notes: The EAN does have an official logo, but on ean.org it exists only as inline SVG embedded directly in the HTML of every page header and footer (elements with class logo-main__img and logo-mobile__img, viewBox 0 0 2911.7 976.4 and 0 0 3741.732 1870.866). Inline SVG has no retrievable asset URL, so no direct image URL can be proven from the live site. I then walked the official brand-asset pages on the same domain: Media & Press, the congress 2025 and 2027 promotional kits, and the congress 2026 and 2027 industry download centres. The only downloadable EAN brand files are congress-branded archives - ean_Congress_Logo_2026_Geneva_Package.zip and ean_logos_the_home_of_neurology_Trademark.zip - and EAN's own Corporate Design Manual states that the 'home of Neurology' version 'is only used during the congress and only for giveaways and merchandise items'. Those are congress variants and ZIP archives rather than an image asset, so they are the wrong identity for a fellowship programme record. Leaving image_url null is the truthful result rather than filling it with a congress banner, a favicon, or a logo variant EAN restricts to congress use.
